notes.title: Short Update
notes.content:
Dear Community,

we apologize, also in the name of Harold, for not communicating with you. Unfortunately the world wide situation is affecting us too but we are looking forward and would like to give you a short update.

The new release date of Finding Brenda Episode 1 is now February 25th, 2020.

From now on we will keep you updated. Also you can follow us on Twitter!

Kind regards,
your Finding Brenda development team

notes.title: Bug fixes demo version
notes.content:
Thanks for your feedback!

We fixed several little bugs and added some small stuff.

[list]
[*]Basement scene: cutscene bars are now disappearing
[*]End cutscene in Harolds house: Music and sound effects changed
[*]Gas station scene: birds and music are now played when the player enters the scene again
[/list]
